subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should OpenAI-compatible and OAuth image-generation responses reject each individual base64 image above the existing configured `mediaMaxMb` budget, even when the aggregate HTTP response previously allowed that image to decode?
rationale: The branch deliberately converts a formerly accepted over-budget individual image into an existing missing-image failure; source-level safety evidence supports the guard, but the acceptable provider compatibility contract is a maintainer product and upgrade decision.

options.title: Adopt the per-image budget
options.body: Accept the existing configured media budget as a per-image admission limit, preserving the proposed guard and its mixed-response behavior.

options.title: Keep aggregate-only semantics
options.body: Retain the current aggregate HTTP response cap for OpenAI-compatible/OAuth responses and limit this PR to paths whose per-item budget is already an established contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the per-image budget
recommendation.body: Accept the existing configured media budget as a per-image admission limit, preserving the proposed guard and its mixed-response behavior.
